obfuscation_indicators: policies designed to mitigate credit risk
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative and transparent, showing improved earnings, loan and deposit growth, and reduced borrowings. Risk factors include declining net interest margin, increased interest expense, reliance on collateral valuations and qualitative allowance adjustments, and exposure to regional commercial real estate lending. Management uses some standard boilerplate and forward-looking language, but provides meaningful numerical detail.
